name: Engineering Mechanics
description: Kinematics, general motion of a rigid body, mass and center of mass; resultant force systems, Euler’s axioms; equations of equilibrium, impulse and angular impulse, inertia tensor; principal axes; angular impulse-momentum relations; Euler’s equations, work-energy relation, impact of rigid bodies, equations of equilibrium, trusses, beams, friction and impending motion (rolling and tipping), principle of virtual work, Lagrange’s equations, Hamilton’s principle.
